centroid.description: The cluster's representative point, used to compute a hop's straight-line km and thus its min_plausible_mins floor. Optional in schema (old routing.yaml stays valid); required by the itinerary gate's verdicts_rederivable check for every district a hop names as an endpoint -- scripts/rederive.py::hop_km returns None without it, and rederive_hops fails the hop rather than silently skipping the floor.

mode.description: Travel mode, used as the min_plausible_mins speed floor's key. Optional in schema (old routing.yaml stays valid); required by the itinerary gate's verdicts_rederivable check -- a hop with no mode cannot have its floor recomputed and scripts/rederive.py::rederive_hops fails it rather than silently degrading to a threshold-only compare.

flag.description: Verdict from scripts/distance.py::classify_hop. `implausible` and `unsourced` were previously unrepresentable, which meant an honest recording of either produced a schema-invalid artifact — raising the guessed minutes was the only schema-valid escape. (TW-066)

duration_source.description: Where `mins` came from. Optional in schema (old routing.yaml stays valid); required by the itinerary gate. An absent value is treated as agent_estimate. (TW-066)

source_url.description: The timetable / map result backing `mins` when duration_source is not agent_estimate.

then.description: I1: a hop declaring a SOURCED duration_source must carry source_url -- re-typing the enum alone (with no source) used to clear classify_hop's `unsourced` verdict; this closes the same bare-enum gap Task 2 closed for business_status. Scoped to hops that explicitly declare a non-default duration_source (transition rule): a hop with no duration_source field at all, or an explicit `agent_estimate`, is unaffected -- every pre-TW-066 artifact keeps validating.
